lyrics.text: 如果非要做个比喻 你像是一条街
lyrics.romanization: Rúguǒ fēi yào zuò gè bǐyù nǐ xiàng shì yī tiáo jiē
lyrics.translate: If I had to make a metaphor, you're like a street

lyrics.text: 街道的路灯忽明忽暗 藏匿住情节
lyrics.romanization: Jiēdào de lùdēng hū míng hū àn cángnì zhù qíngjié
lyrics.translate: The streetlights flicker, hiding the storyline

lyrics.text: 如果非要做个比喻 你像是一条线
lyrics.romanization: Rúguǒ fēi yào zuò gè bǐyù nǐ xiàng shì yī tiáo xiàn
lyrics.translate: If I had to make a metaphor, you're like a thread

lyrics.text: 牵着你的心 扣动某人的心弦
lyrics.romanization: Qiān zhe nǐ de xīn kòu dòng mǒurén de xīnxián
lyrics.translate: Pulling your heart, tugging at someone's heartstrings

lyrics.romanization: Yuè lái yuè yuǎn de gàobié
lyrics.translate: The goodbye that's fading further away

lyrics.romanization: Zhōngjiū biànchéng le tǎoyàn
lyrics.translate: Ultimately turned into resentment

lyrics.romanization: Huíyì zài yùyǎnyùliè
lyrics.translate: The memories are growing more intense

lyrics.romanization: Méi tōngguò nǐ shuō de kǎoyàn
lyrics.translate: I didn't pass the test you mentioned

lyrics.romanization: Shuōhǎo de yīqǐ màoxiǎn
lyrics.translate: We agreed to go on an adventure together

lyrics.romanization: Zhōngjiū biànchéng le xiāoqiǎn
lyrics.translate: But it ultimately became just a pastime

lyrics.text: Darling 你不懂我对你那种感情
lyrics.romanization: Darling nǐ bù dǒng wǒ duì nǐ nà zhǒng gǎnqíng
lyrics.translate: Darling, you don't understand the feelings I have for you

lyrics.text: 就好像经历过了生死别离
lyrics.romanization: Jiù hǎoxiàng jīnglì guòle shēngsǐ biélí
lyrics.translate: It feels like going through a life-and-death parting

lyrics.text: 别留我一个人房间里伤心
lyrics.romanization: Bié liú wǒ yīgè rén fángjiān lǐ shāngxīn
lyrics.translate: Don't leave me alone breaking my heart in this room

lyrics.romanization: Zhè jièduàn fǎnyìng
lyrics.translate: These withdrawal symptoms

lyrics.text: 像毒药侵蚀着我的身体
lyrics.romanization: Xiàng dúyào qīnshí zhe wǒ de shēntǐ
lyrics.translate: Are corroding my body like poison

lyrics.romanization: Tài duō sìcéngxiāngshí de chǎngjǐng
lyrics.translate: Too many familiar scenes

lyrics.text: 让我如何忘掉你裙上的柳丁
lyrics.romanization: Ràng wǒ rúhé wàngdiào nǐ qún shàng de liǔdīng
lyrics.translate: How can I forget the studs on your skirt?

lyrics.romanization: Gàosù wǒ rúhé wàngjì
lyrics.translate: Tell me, how do I forget?

lyrics.romanization: Rúhé jiè diào jiǔjīng
lyrics.translate: How do I quit alcohol?

lyrics.romanization: 《Nǎlǐ dōu shì nǐ》
lyrics.translate: "You Are Everywhere"

lyrics.romanization: Zhè shì yī dào nántí
lyrics.translate: This is a tough problem

lyrics.romanization: Nǐ kàn bù dǒng wǒ
lyrics.translate: You don't understand me

lyrics.romanization: Wǒ yě gǎo bù dǒng nǐ
lyrics.translate: And I can't figure you out either

lyrics.text: 我爱写love song 你爱听Central Cee
lyrics.romanization: Wǒ ài xiě love song nǐ ài tīng Central Cee
lyrics.translate: I love writing love songs, you love listening to Central Cee

lyrics.text: 我们喜欢听两种不同风格的音乐
lyrics.romanization: Wǒmen xǐhuān tīng liǎng zhǒng bùtóng fēnggé de yīnyuè
lyrics.translate: We like listening to two different styles of music

lyrics.text: 你喜欢新鲜的感觉 我怀念旧的经典
lyrics.romanization: Nǐ xǐhuān xīnxiān de gǎnjué wǒ huáiniàn jiù de jīngdiǎn
lyrics.translate: You like fresh feelings, I miss the old classics

lyrics.text: 我怀念那条街 总在放着老唱片
lyrics.romanization: Wǒ huáiniàn nà tiáo jiē zǒng zài fàng zhe lǎo chàngpiàn
lyrics.translate: I miss that street that was always playing old records

lyrics.text: 那熟悉的声音 却总是听不见
lyrics.romanization: Nà shúxī de shēngyīn què zǒng shì tīng bù jiàn
lyrics.translate: Yet that familiar voice can never be heard
